text.description_html:
Bommer 7114, Spring Door Pivot Hinge Box Clamp Mounted

Bommer Industries has been in business since 1876, with over 125 years of quality products. Their products are American made with American steel.

Bommer 7114 Spring Door Pivot Hinge, Box Clamp Mounted. Cast Steel construction pivot hinge for doors up to 36 Inches Wide, 1-1/8 Inches Thick with a Maximum Door Weight of 75 lbs.

Specifications for the Bommer 7114 Pivot for a 1-1/8" Thick Door:

  • Maximum Door Width: 36"
  • Maximum Door Thickness: 1-1/8"
  • Maximum Door Weight: 75 lbs.
  • Cast Steel Construction
  • Box Clamp Mounted Pivot
  • Double Acting
  • Maximum Swing: 130º each direction
  • Ball Bearing Pivot
  • Non-Handed
  • Adjustable Spring Tension
  • Box Clamp Door Bracket For Doors 1-1/8" Thick
  • Flat Jamb Bracket: 1-1/4" Wide
  • Packaged with #12 - 1-1/4", #10 - 1" Flat Head Wood Screws and Thru-Bolts for Box Clamp
  • Bommer 7114 Dimensions (PDF)
  • How to Reactivate Tension on Bommer Spring Pivots

Sold individually as a set, with 1 pivot , 1 each jamb and door bracket, 1 top pivot assembly with jamb bracket, and mounting screw hardware. Enough to do one door.
